bio.text: Maggie Goodlander represents New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District, to which she was elected in November 2024.
She was born and raised in Nashua and began her career as a foreign policy advisor to Senator John McCain, then served more than a decade as an intelligence officer in the U.S. Navy Reserve.

She clerked for Justice Stephen Breyer on the U.S. Supreme Court, taught constitutional law at the University of New Hampshire and Dartmouth, and served as a Deputy Assistant Attorney General at the U.S. Department of Justice.
Before Congress she was a senior advisor at the White House.
